# Draft:Hamish Warden

Hamish Warden (born 27 July 1999) is an Australian-Swiss basketball player who has played professionally in Australia, Switzerland, and Italy.
Early life
Warden was born in Perth, Western Australia.
College career
Warden played college basketball in the United States for Notre Dame College, competing in NCAA Division II.
Professional career
Australia
Warden began his senior career in Australia, playing in the State Basketball League (SBL) and NBL1.
He has played for several teams, including the Perry Lakes Hawks, East Perth Eagles, Joondalup Wolves, and Albury–Wodonga Bandits.
In 2022, he made his debut for the Bandits.
Switzerland
Warden has played in the Swiss Basketball League (SBL) for clubs including BBC Nyon, Lugano Tigers, and SAM Basket Massagno.
He has also been under contract with Swiss clubs during multiple seasons.
Italy
In Italy, Warden has competed Serie B Interregionale.
He signed with Basket School Messina.
Return to Australia
Warden later returned to Australia to continue playing in NBL1.
International career
Warden has represented Switzerland in international competition.
He has participated in FIBA EuroBasket pre-qualification matches for the Swiss national team.
